local_value: Under canonical coefficient g/(6a5 eps16 b), gives a^j/(6a5)*v^k times designated jet. Corrections from a−zeta have weight>=12 and do not affect the cutoff7 quotient. Vandermonde on six roots a6=-1 is invertible.
scope: Explicit surjectivity on the GENERIC vertex-defect jet bundles, already satisfying the two generic center adjoints. Additional adjoints at special-v/collision/discriminant loci may restrict the section source and remain unresolved.
